title: MCP Server Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Supports stdio, SSE, and streamable-http server types with comprehensive validation.

oneOf.title: Streamable HTTP Server Configuration

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this MCP server without removing its configuration. Useful for temporarily disabling servers during development or troubleshooting.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for server connection and responses. If the server doesn't respond within this time, the connection will be terminated. Range: 1-3600 seconds (1 second to 1 hour).

alwaysAllow.description: List of tool names that can be executed automatically without requiring user confirmation. Use this for trusted tools that you want to run without interruption. Tool names must match exactly as provided by the MCP server.

watchPaths.description: File paths or glob patterns to watch for changes. When files matching these patterns change, the MCP server will automatically restart. Useful for development when you're modifying server code. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

disabledTools.description: List of tool names to disable for this server. These tools will not be available even if the server provides them. Useful for restricting access to potentially dangerous operations or tools you don't want to use.

type.description: Server type identifier. Must be 'streamable-http' for HTTP streaming servers. These servers use standard HTTP requests with streaming responses, allowing for efficient bidirectional communication.

url.description: The HTTP/HTTPS URL endpoint of the streamable HTTP server. This is where the extension will send requests and receive streaming responses. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Required for streamable-http servers.
url.errorMessage: URL must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include with each request to the server. Commonly used for authentication (Authorization header), API keys, content negotiation, or custom metadata. All header values must be strings.

oneOf.description: Streamable HTTP server configuration - connects to a remote MCP server via HTTP with streaming support. Best for RESTful MCP services or when you need standard HTTP-based communication with streaming capabilities. Each request is independent but can stream responses.

errorMessage.required: Streamable HTTP servers must have 'type' and 'url' fields
errorMessage.not: Cannot mix URL-based fields (url, headers) with 'stdio' fields (command, args, env, cwd)

oneOf.title: SSE Server Configuration

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this MCP server without removing its configuration. Useful for temporarily disabling servers during development or troubleshooting.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for server connection and responses. If the server doesn't respond within this time, the connection will be terminated. Range: 1-3600 seconds (1 second to 1 hour).

alwaysAllow.description: List of tool names that can be executed automatically without requiring user confirmation. Use this for trusted tools that you want to run without interruption. Tool names must match exactly as provided by the MCP server.

watchPaths.description: File paths or glob patterns to watch for changes. When files matching these patterns change, the MCP server will automatically restart. Useful for development when you're modifying server code. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

disabledTools.description: List of tool names to disable for this server. These tools will not be available even if the server provides them. Useful for restricting access to potentially dangerous operations or tools you don't want to use.

type.description: Server type identifier. Must be 'sse' for Server-Sent Events servers. SSE servers use HTTP streaming to maintain a persistent connection and receive real-time updates from the server.

url.description: The HTTP/HTTPS URL endpoint of the SSE server. This is where the extension will connect to establish the Server-Sent Events stream. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Required for SSE servers.
url.errorMessage: URL must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include with the SSE connection request. Commonly used for authentication (Authorization header), API keys, or custom metadata. All header values must be strings.

oneOf.description: SSE (Server-Sent Events) server configuration - connects to a remote MCP server via HTTP streaming. Best for cloud-hosted MCP servers or services that need to push real-time updates. The server maintains a persistent HTTP connection.

errorMessage.required: SSE servers must have 'type' and 'url' fields
errorMessage.not: Cannot mix URL-based fields (url, headers) with 'stdio' fields (command, args, env, cwd)

oneOf.title: Stdio Server Configuration

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this MCP server without removing its configuration. Useful for temporarily disabling servers during development or troubleshooting.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for server connection and responses. If the server doesn't respond within this time, the connection will be terminated. Range: 1-3600 seconds (1 second to 1 hour).

alwaysAllow.description: List of tool names that can be executed automatically without requiring user confirmation. Use this for trusted tools that you want to run without interruption. Tool names must match exactly as provided by the MCP server.

watchPaths.description: File paths or glob patterns to watch for changes. When files matching these patterns change, the MCP server will automatically restart. Useful for development when you're modifying server code. Paths can be absolute or relative to the workspace root.

disabledTools.description: List of tool names to disable for this server. These tools will not be available even if the server provides them. Useful for restricting access to potentially dangerous operations or tools you don't want to use.

type.description: Server type identifier. For stdio servers, this is optional and automatically inferred when 'command' is provided. Stdio servers communicate via standard input/output streams with a local process.

command.description: The executable command to run the MCP server. This can be a system command (like 'node', 'python', 'npx') or a path to an executable. The server will communicate via stdin/stdout. Required for stdio servers.

args.description: Command-line arguments to pass to the command. These are passed in order as separate arguments. Use this to specify server scripts, configuration files, or runtime options.

cwd.description: Working directory for the command execution. If not specified, defaults to the workspace root directory. Use absolute paths or paths relative to the workspace root.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the server process. These are merged with the system environment. Useful for passing API keys, configuration paths, or runtime settings. All values must be strings.

oneOf.description: Stdio server configuration - communicates with a local process via standard input/output streams. Best for locally-installed MCP servers or custom scripts. The server process is spawned and managed by the extension.

errorMessage.required: Stdio servers must have a 'command' field
errorMessage.not: Cannot mix 'stdio' fields (command, args, env) with URL-based fields (url, headers)

errorMessage.oneOf: Server configuration must be one of: stdio (with 'command'), sse (with 'type':'sse' and 'url'), or streamable-http (with 'type':'streamable-http' and 'url')

mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations. Each key is a unique server name, and the value is the server configuration.
